appearance_instruction: Present a grounded railway-platform reunion with natural human proportions, subdued travel clothing, and consistent station lighting.

semantic_keyframes.visible_state: Two people are clearly separated on the platform, with actor_a at the left and actor_b waiting at the right.
actor_states: actor_a stands at the starting position facing actor_b
actor_b waits at the destination position facing actor_a
must_not_show: either actor already close to the other

semantic_keyframes.visible_state: Actor_a has begun a deliberate approach while a substantial gap remains.
actor_states: actor_a takes the first steps toward actor_b

semantic_keyframes.visible_state: Actor_a continues across the platform and the distance between the pair is visibly smaller than before.
Actor_a is near actor_b but a small readable separation is still present.
actor_states: actor_b continues waiting without changing position

semantic_keyframes.visible_state: Actor_a finishes beside actor_b at a natural reunion distance, with both people fully visible.
actor_states: actor_a comes to a controlled stop near actor_b
actor_b remains in place and acknowledges the arrival

transitions.cause: actor_a recognizes actor_b and initiates the reunion approach
transitions.continuous_change: actor_a changes from standing to forward movement

transitions.cause: actor_a continues toward the waiting actor
transitions.continuous_change: the distance between the actors steadily decreases

transitions.cause: the uninterrupted approach brings actor_a near actor_b
transitions.continuous_change: actor_a advances and begins to slow

transitions.cause: actor_a reaches the intended reunion distance
transitions.continuous_change: forward motion eases into a stable stop

causal_constraints: actor_a must begin moving before the inter-person distance can decrease
near-arrival must follow a continuous approach
the final stop must occur only after actor_a reaches reunion distance
must_avoid: premature contact before the final state
uncertain_assumptions: actor_b remains stationary throughout the five-second event
reunion distance means close proximity without requiring an embrace
